name: Sumeragi Kensei
source:
The formidable leader of the Kurojou-gumi, who's renowned for his arrogance and scheming nature.

He is the CEO of a major corporation in Tenkai District, spearheading a major urban development.

He has skyrocketed to dominance in the criminal underworld, rapidly expanding his gang through sheer wealth and influence

Part of Kurojou-gumi
